theme_archetype: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Growth, Calm) blended with Editorial Pizazz

dependencies_to_add.framer-motion: Required for staggered scroll reveals, hover lifts, and smooth micro-interactions. Pizazz requires motion.
dependencies_to_add.lucide-react: For crisp, modern SVG icons to replace anything dowdy.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft ambient shadows (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]) instead of harsh ones. For dark surfaces, drop shadows aren't needed, use border highlights.
visual_enhancers.borders: Replace universal flat borders with 1px border-black/5 on light themes or border-white/10 on dark sections to create subtle depth without looking rigid.
visual_enhancers.radii: Use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for an organic, modern feel, rather than sharp squares.
visual_enhancers.depth: Layer sections! Make elements overlap slightly across section boundaries (like the value-prop strip overlapping the hero).

hero.layout: Full-bleed section. min-h-[85vh] lg:min-h-[90vh] flex flex-col justify-end pb-24 md:pb-32 relative overflow-hidden. Switch to Dark theme context.
hero.typography: text-sand. H1 is massive, font-serif, max-w-4xl.
hero.visuals: Hero image acts as an absolute background anchor with object-cover, overlayed with a gradient bg-gradient-to-t from-forest via-forest/80 to-forest/20 so the text is fully readable.
hero.motion: Fade up text and CTAs staggered by 0.15s.
hero.ctas: Ask Nadar: bg-terracotta text-sand rounded-full px-8 py-3. See Guide: bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-sand rounded-full. Set Region: subtle underline link text-sand.

value_prop_strip.layout: Floating horizontal layout overlapping the Hero and the Ethos section. -mt-16 md:-mt-20 relative z-10 mx-auto max-w-5xl px-6.
value_prop_strip.typography: text-ink, text-sm md:text-base font-medium text-center md:text-left.
value_prop_strip.motion: Use Framer Motion to slide it up slightly on load.

ethos_band.layout: Editorial asymmetrical split. 40% large text block, 60% flowing organic imagery. py-24
ethos_band.typography: Massive serif quote 'Grow your own, anywhere'. text-forest.

this_month_card.layout: Organic, rounded-3xl card highlighting dynamic seasonal elements.
this_month_card.visuals: Add a terracotta accent badge or subtle top border line to draw the eye. Make the data feel like a dashboard widget.

feature_grid.layout: Mode A: THE TETRIS GRID (Bento Box). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6.
feature_grid.strategy: CRITICAL FIX: Destroy the flat cream card rhythm. Assign distinct colors and sizes to features.

items.masterclasses: col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden relative. bg-forest text-sand p-8. Massive serif title. Include a subtle background image with low opacity.
items.cut_flowers: col-span-full md:col-span-4 row-span-1 rounded-3xl p-6. bg-terracotta text-sand. Playful right-aligned icon.
items.first_pot: col-span-full md:col-span-4 row-span-1 rounded-3xl p-6. bg-surface text-ink border border-moss/10.
items.space_saving: col-span-full md:col-span-4 row-span-2 rounded-3xl p-6 flex flex-col justify-between. bg-moss text-sand. Tall card format.
items.companion_planting: col-span-full md:col-span-4 row-span-1 rounded-3xl p-6. bg-sand text-ink border border-moss/20.
items.regrow: col-span-full md:col-span-4 row-span-1 rounded-3xl p-6. bg-surface text-ink border border-moss/10.
items.plants_database: col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-1 rounded-3xl p-6. glass-panel overlaid on a subtle plant background.

feature_grid.motion: Use Framer Motion 'whileInView' with viewport={{ once: true, margin: '-50px' }} to stagger the entrance of the bento boxes (0.1s stagger).

editorial_pull_quote.layout: Massive central focus block. max-w-4xl mx-auto text-center py-32.
editorial_pull_quote.typography: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl text-moss font-serif italic. Remove the boring box.

wellbeing_band.layout: Grid split: Sticky large typography on the left (md:col-span-1), 3 stacked vertical cards on the right (md:col-span-1). py-24.
wellbeing_band.cards: Notice / Slow / Nourish. Make them bg-forest rounded-2xl p-8 mb-6 last:mb-0.

plant_of_the_week.layout: Editorial feature card. grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-0 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden.
plant_of_the_week.visuals: Col 1: Object-cover image. Col 2 & 3: Info pane p-8 md:p-12 with bg-surface text-ink.

popular_plants_and_loved_patches.layout: Horizontal overflow-x-auto snap-x flex gap-6 pb-8 hide-scrollbar. DO NOT use static flat cards.
popular_plants_and_loved_patches.cards: Image dominant cards (aspect-[4/5]), rounded-2xl. Title sits at the bottom inside a dark gradient overlay.

bundle_cta.layout: Massive conversion panel. grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-center py-24.
bundle_cta.left_col: Huge 'Grow for life' text, 5 bullet points with terracotta checkmarks.
bundle_cta.price_card: bg-surface border-2 border-terracotta rounded-3xl p-8 lg:p-12 relative overflow-hidden shadow-2xl. Add a glowing radial gradient of terracotta in the top right corner to grab attention.

hero_planting.description: Woman planting a small houseplant in a pot on a balcony (Use as background anchor in Hero)

ethos_gardening.description: Person planting seedlings in raised bed (Use in Ethos section imagery)

feature_potted_plant.description: Green plant in white ceramic pot (Use as subtle background for masterclasses or space-saving card)

feature_cut_flowers.description: Variety of flowers bouquet (Use in Cut Flowers bento block)

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT change the color hex codes. Apply them heavily as background colors to create section contrast instead of just text colors.
Do NOT remove any existing text or sections from Home.jsx.
You MUST preserve all `data-testid` attributes exactly as requested.
Implement the 'Bento Grid Protocol' for the feature grid to fix the 'dull, dowdy' issue. Alternate colors (bg-forest, bg-terracotta, bg-sand, bg-surface) for different feature cards.
Install and use `framer-motion` to add scroll reveals to the panels.
Convert borders from thick/dark to subtle (border-black/5 or border-white/10). Rely on background color changes for section separation.
Ensure all text has adequate contrast. For instance, text-sand on bg-forest, text-sand on bg-terracotta.
Update Home.jsx using these exact principles. Treat it like an editorial magazine (overlap elements, varying card sizes, massive typography for quotes).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
